flashcard_questions.q: The person responsible for the overall artistic vision of a production, who works with actors and designers, leads rehearsals, gives notes, and agrees blocking.
The planned movement and positioning of actors on stage during a performance, agreed between the director and actors.
A pivotal event that sets the main action of a play in motion, triggering all subsequent events.
